summary: Hyperscale Data filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement amending its June 18, 2026 at-the-market sales agreement with Spartan Capital Securities, cutting the maximum aggregate offering from $300 million to $100 million. As of October 9, 2026, the company had sold 121,827,841 Class A shares for $49,781,885 gross, leaving roughly $50,218,115 available. Shares trade on NYSE American under GPUS at $0.1569 as of October 9. Spartan earns 3.0% commission; no escrow. This is a routine shelf takedown amendment, not a special situation. Watch dilution pace and share-price pressure.
